connector.name: SEO Performance MCP
connector.registryDescription: Per-URL SEO verdicts from GSC, GA4, Matomo, Clarity, AI citations: refresh/expand/merge/kill.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package seo-performance-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the automatelab-tech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
env.description: Base64-encoded Google service account JSON with Search Console read access.

env.name: GSC_SITE_URL
env.description: Search Console site URL (e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/).

env.name: MATOMO_TOKEN
env.description: Matomo auth token with view access.

env.name: MATOMO_SITE_ID
env.description: Matomo idSite for the site to query.

env.name: GA4_PROPERTY_ID
env.description: GA4 property ID (numeric, no G- prefix).

env.name: GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
env.description: Base64-encoded Google service account JSON with GA4 Data API access.

env.name: CLARITY_API_TOKEN
env.description: Microsoft Clarity Data Export API token.

env.name: POSTS_SITEMAP_URL
env.description: XML sitemap URL used to enumerate posts. Primary platform-agnostic discovery path.

env.name: POSTS_LIST
env.description: Optional JSON array overriding sitemap discovery.

env.name: GHOST_ADMIN_API_URL
env.description: Optional. Ghost Admin API base URL. Pair with GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY for richer metadata.

env.name: GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Ghost Admin API key in the form id:secret.

env.name: CITATION_INTELLIGENCE_URL
env.description: Optional URL of a citation-intelligence MCP server to delegate AI-citation queries to.
